name: @kody-smoke/inbox-hooks
description: Records inbound webhook deliveries and email events in packageStorage(); exercised by smoke/webhooks.mjs and smoke/email.mjs.

webhooks.name: github
webhooks.description: GitHub push/issue events; verified with the shared secret and deduplicated by delivery id.

webhooks.name: stripe
webhooks.description: Stripe events; Stripe-Signature t=/v1= verification with a 5 minute replay window.

webhooks.name: plain
webhooks.description: Unsigned JSON webhook; the body becomes the export's params and the return value is the HTTP response.

email.message.received.description: Files every inbound email's id + subject.
